title: Event-store idempotency fixtures contaminate shared integration state
notes: Cluster B from the final integration run: 14 failures involving TC-ISS-203-01..05, TC-ES-03-01, TC-EE-08-04, TC-EE-10-04/05/06, TC-ISS-202-01, and TC-EXT-01-INT-07. Deterministic IDs reuse rows and trigger PostgreSQL 23505 on uq_event_idempotency; cleanup then fails on foreign-key references. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 6798-8490 and 8717-13212.
root_cause: Initial hypothesis: integration fixtures reuse deterministic event and idempotency identifiers across cases or binaries sharing one database, while cleanup is incomplete or ordered before dependent rows are removed.
candidate_resolution: Generate per-test UUIDs/idempotency keys, isolate each fixture transaction or namespace, and make cleanup delete dependents before event-store rows while remaining unconditional after failures.
